additional_info.subject: ID0468096-DC/Si-D/CZ-[MP / S4 170003580] No Outlets visible on the HMI CRM:02888000506
additional_info.body:
Hi Milan, good morning.
I checked this charger and indeed it's not working as intended.
Can you please tell me if you started facing this after the v8.1.4 update? If yes, the best I can do for you right now is to downgrade to v8.0.5.
I already faced this issue with another charger from a different region and a ticket to R&D has been created. But since we are in holiday season, things might take a while.
Let me know if you want to downgrade or if we keep it like this.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
